# posting account

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:postingAccount`](gmeow-postingAccount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/postingAccount>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ledger account this posting affects. Functional: a posting affects exactly one ledger account.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Posting`](../classes/gmeow-Posting.md) -> [`gmeow:LedgerAccount`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerAccount.md); functional
